_doc: ADR-0102 D-A/D-B/D-C/D-D & ADR-0103 D-A/D-B/D-C: Shared specification file for plain-language generator principles, controlled vocabulary substitution table, and three-face reach (grill-mental-model, ledger D-006, D-007, D-010, D-013). Governed under change tickets via the ADR mechanism.

generator_principles.title: One word, one meaning
generator_principles.statute: A concept carries exactly one name. Reject compound welding of new jargon for existing concepts.

generator_principles.title: Complete short sentences
generator_principles.statute: Write complete short sentences without long welded noun chains.
generator_principles.guidance: Two explanation-layer notes (r3 D-003①, registered 2026-10-19, ADR-0102 D-A guidance layer — the statutory cap of three principles is untouched): a metaphor is either defined in CONTEXT.md or dropped; an abbreviation is expanded at first use.
generator_principles.origin: Sweden plain-language statutory form / US Plain Writing Act

generator_principles.title: Register before use
generator_principles.statute: A new term must have a CONTEXT.md entry before it may appear in mandatory faces.

substitution_table.definition: 未登记词或概念的豁免出口。不是一种特权放行机制，而是通过收词分诊通道登记并延后处理。
substitution_table.context: 严禁用'豁免阀'跳过规范，未登记词须入分诊通道。
substitution_table.substitute: 收词分诊通道 / 延后处理项
substitution_table.reason: The term 豁免阀 (exemption valve) is forbidden by the ADR-0102 D-B wording law (inherited from ADR-0098 D-C; ADR-0100 retired in 62a71522); triage discloses and defers, but never exempts.

substitution_table.definition: 两个独立、有效且可审计的防护屏障组合。不是把未经资格认定的普通规则简单计数叠加以制造虚假安全感。
substitution_table.context: 两道独立防护经 IPL 验证合格后方可计为双重屏障。
substitution_table.reason: Counting unqualified rules as barriers manufactures a false sense of multiple protection (ADR-0101 D-C / Primatech warning).
substitution_table.condition: Rules must pass the IPL triple test (effective, independent, auditable) before counting as barriers.

substitution_table.definition: 多层纵深防御工程架构。在本项目架构映射中不是指预防屏障与减缓屏障的模糊混合，而是指两层各自独立的工程属性。
substitution_table.context: 系统在通用软件架构层采用 defense-in-depth，在双 profile 映射上遵循 Bow-tie 预防与减缓分离。
substitution_table.substitute: Bow-tie 骨架 (独立预防屏障 + 减缓屏障)
substitution_table.reason: Defense-in-depth is an engineering property, not the bow-tie architectural mapping; prevention and mitigation layers remain strictly independent (ADR-0101 D-A).
substitution_table.condition: Used strictly in the context of generic software defense in depth rather than the two-profile architecture mapping.

substitution_table.definition: 第二方独立验证审计代理。不是共同作者或协作编写者，而是持阻断权力的独立审查者。
substitution_table.context: 验证 profile 由独立审计 agent 运行，禁止与主 agent 混淆职责。
substitution_table.substitute: auditor / reviewer / second agent (独立审计 agent / 审查者)
substitution_table.reason: Jargon coinage. A concept carries plain established names; Digital.gov plain writing standards reject giving familiar concepts manufactured names (D-010, ADR-0103 D-B).
substitution_table.condition: Deprecated retired coinage (r2 BK-08 downgrade, registered 2026-10-19): historical text (accepted ADRs, prior ledgers, commit messages) stays as written under the append-only discipline; new output names the role plainly (auditor / reviewer / second agent). Re-promotion into the avoid tier requires the four-criteria review at P1 (after the MAST separability gate passes), never before.

substitution_table.definition: 未经平实语言审查和登记而随意发明的生造晦涩词汇。不是已被领域公认的标准术语。
substitution_table.context: 技术写作中应选用通用熟词，避免发明自造生词。
substitution_table.reason: Reflexive plain-language discipline. Plain words carry the meaning directly without imposing manufactured vocabulary (D-010, ADR-0103 D-B).
substitution_table.condition: Deprecated retired coinage (r2 BK-08 downgrade, registered 2026-10-19): historical text (accepted ADRs, prior ledgers, commit messages) stays as written under the append-only discipline; new output says neologism or jargon. Re-promotion into the avoid tier requires the four-criteria review at P1 (after the MAST separability gate passes), never before.

substitution_table.definition: 两个独立的判定实例或双模型交叉评估机制。不是具有拟人或神秘绑定的'孪生体'。
substitution_table.context: 通过双模型独立裁决与交叉对比保证判决客观性。
substitution_table.substitute: dual judges / 双重判定 / 双评估者
substitution_table.reason: Hyphen compound jargon. Plain technical terms exist for independent dual evaluation (D-010, ADR-0103 D-B).
substitution_table.condition: Deprecated retired coinage (r2 BK-08 downgrade, registered 2026-10-19): historical text (accepted ADRs, prior ledgers, commit messages) stays as written under the append-only discipline; new output says independent dual evaluation. Re-promotion into the avoid tier requires the four-criteria review at P1 (after the MAST separability gate passes), never before.

substitution_table.definition: 在提示词前置中加入对抗性防范指令以抵御模型退化。不是生物医学上的物理疫苗接种。
substitution_table.context: 在系统提示中注入防范提示以规范输出风格。
substitution_table.substitute: pre-briefing / prompt defense / 防范提示 / 免疫提示
substitution_table.reason: Metaphorical jargon violating Digital.gov rules against assigning non-standard meanings to common words (D-010, ADR-0103 D-B).
substitution_table.condition: Deprecated retired coinage (r2 BK-08 downgrade, registered 2026-10-19): historical text (accepted ADRs, prior ledgers, commit messages) stays as written under the append-only discipline; new output names the concept in plain established words rather than reusing a medical metaphor. Re-promotion into the avoid tier requires the four-criteria review at P1 (after the MAST separability gate passes), never before.

substitution_table.definition: 指涉对象具备持久物理实体身份（有固定生命周期和实体标识），区别于纯瞬时字符串 ID 或瞬态标记。
substitution_table.context: 权限校验必须在 entity-level 确认物理资源所有权，不可仅凭请求中的字符串 ID。
substitution_table.substitute: entity-level (保留，区分物理实体与瞬态标识符)
substitution_table.reason: Marks a real domain distinction between ephemeral identifiers and persistent entity identity (D-010, ADR-0103 D-B).
substitution_table.condition: Used to distinguish persistent entity identity from transient string identifiers.

substitution_table.definition: 规则或门禁演进中只允许单调变严格、不允许放宽松。不是不可解释的专有修饰词。
substitution_table.context: 门禁阈值调整遵循单调收紧纪律，禁止放宽既有检查。
substitution_table.substitute: monotonic restriction / 单调收紧 / 仅收紧
substitution_table.reason: Hyphen compound jargon. Standard mathematical/engineering language ('monotonic') carries the meaning precisely (D-010, ADR-0103 D-B).
substitution_table.condition: Deprecated retired coinage (r2 BK-08 downgrade, registered 2026-10-19): historical text (accepted ADRs, prior ledgers, commit messages) stays as written under the append-only discipline; new output says monotonic (no-relaxation). Re-promotion into the avoid tier requires the four-criteria review at P1 (after the MAST separability gate passes), never before.

substitution_table.definition: 参考现有标准或成熟架构进行的衍生设计。不是一种独特的专有关系。
substitution_table.context: 该模块参考 ESLint 门禁分级设计，继承其成熟语义。
substitution_table.substitute: derived from / modeled on / 参考设计
substitution_table.reason: Hyphen compound jargon where standard English verbs ('derived from', 'modeled on') are clearer (D-010, ADR-0103 D-B).
substitution_table.condition: Deprecated retired coinage (r2 BK-08 downgrade, registered 2026-10-19): historical text (accepted ADRs, prior ledgers, commit messages) stays as written under the append-only discipline; new output says derived from / modeled on. Re-promotion into the avoid tier requires the four-criteria review at P1 (after the MAST separability gate passes), never before.

substitution_table.definition: 经由实际扫描在当前代码树中真实观察到的词汇或状态。不是假设或推测的存在。
substitution_table.context: 该自造词经代码树实测统计，共发现 18 次出现。
substitution_table.substitute: observed in tree / 当前实测 / 实测存在
substitution_table.reason: Hyphen compound jargon. Plain terms ('observed', 'measured') convey empirical verification directly (D-010, ADR-0103 D-B).
substitution_table.condition: Deprecated retired coinage (r2 BK-08 downgrade, registered 2026-10-19): historical text (accepted ADRs, prior ledgers, commit messages) stays as written under the append-only discipline; new output says observed / measured. Re-promotion into the avoid tier requires the four-criteria review at P1 (after the MAST separability gate passes), never before.

substitution_table.definition: 检查系统产物与源码规范之间是否发生非预期的偏移或偏离。不是神秘专有机制。
substitution_table.context: 在构建步骤中执行一致性检查，防范适配器代码发生漂移。
substitution_table.substitute: regression check / consistency check / 漂移检查 / 一致性检查
substitution_table.reason: Hyphen compound jargon. Standard engineering terms ('drift check', 'consistency check') are plain and familiar (D-010, ADR-0103 D-B).
substitution_table.condition: Deprecated retired coinage (r2 BK-08 downgrade, registered 2026-10-19): historical text (accepted ADRs, prior ledgers, commit messages) stays as written under the append-only discipline; new output says drift check / consistency check. Re-promotion into the avoid tier requires the four-criteria review at P1 (after the MAST separability gate passes), never before.

substitution_table.definition: 在当前审查轮次中因条件未成熟而挂起、留待未来特定触发点再审议的事项。不是永久特权豁免。
substitution_table.context: 该特性因依赖后续实证数据，登记为延后审议项。
substitution_table.substitute: postponed item / deferred item / 延后登记项 / 待决条目
substitution_table.reason: Hyphen compound jargon. Standard project management terms ('postponed', 'deferred item') are completely clear (D-010, ADR-0103 D-B).
substitution_table.condition: Deprecated retired coinage (r2 BK-08 downgrade, registered 2026-10-19): historical text (accepted ADRs, prior ledgers, commit messages) stays as written under the append-only discipline; new output says postponed / deferred item. Re-promotion into the avoid tier requires the four-criteria review at P1 (after the MAST separability gate passes), never before.

mandatory_face.reach: Table plus principles legislated, gate landed (r3 D-003④ wording change, 2026-10-19; the CI gate landed the same round — exit non-zero on unsuppressed avoid-tier hits, ADR-0103 D-E.1). Encompasses git commit messages, ADR bodies, and CONTEXT.md entries.

principle_face.reach: Principles only, no lint (src/SKILL.md). The product face remains plain without lint interruptions.

light_disclosure_face.reach: Principles plus optional future light-disclosure footer for final replies to humans.

three_face_reach.policy: New document types default into the mandatory face; an exception requires an ADR change ticket (ADR-0102 D-D).
